name: My Soldiers
source:
My Soldiers places you in the role of a soldier who's new to a post near the border, you are gonna meet three soldiers here. So "My Soldiers" tells a story that happens in this small post with these guys.

[From [url=https://coolpeng.itch.io/mysoldiers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我的士兵》让你扮演一名新到边境附近哨所的士兵，你将在这里遇到三名士兵。所以“我的士兵”讲述了一个发生在这篇小文章中的故事。

[来自[url=https://coolpeng.itch.io/mysoldiers]itch.io[/url]]
